summary: Opening the local database on a full store (SQLITE_FULL, a full OPFS SAH pool, or 'cannot create file') counted as a wipe-worthy error, so in-process recovery erased a readable database and every write still waiting to upload. Running out of room is now never a reason to erase: the open fails, the app runs on a disposable database, and the next open with room finds the unsent writes intact.
